tests: held lease: follower never evaluates GCRA or reserves credit
rate denial: no lease/TAT advancement and another subject can lead immediately
budget refusal: no GCRA charge, no lease, no provider reservation; next subject is not blocked
multi-market request: one GCRA charge, one reservation, sorted leases and exact stale-market cost
partial overlap: no partial leases or charge; after publish, only missing markets are reserved
reverse-order overlapping market batches and subject arrays do not deadlock or double charge
coarser network and stricter user dimensions remain all-or-none
twenty distinct eligible paid leaders all admit without an artificial concurrency ceiling
freshness recheck under locks prevents a second leader after racing publish
a held-lease follower bypasses a locked subject row
new lease attempt gets a new reservation on every later refresh of the same key
same attempt replay cannot grant a new lease, charge GCRA again or send provider work
both GCRA and budget denials serve flagged stale values; absent cache yields typed denials
fresh cache hit performs one existing read and zero added limiter/budget calls
trusted response observations refresh quota freshness beyond setup plus five minutes
stale/future/replayed observations cannot extend freshness or inflate credit
a late higher header from an older attempt cannot refund after a newer lower observation
without WAF/GCRA the single account still protects interactive floor and collector reserve
explicit rollback removes debit, lease, ledger and GCRA together
server statement/lock timeouts fail safely without a partial combined admission
expired/replaced lease owners cannot publish
uncatalogued events/markets and duplicate market dimensions create no state
catalog caps every allowed market subset at 240 per-market resource rows

fixture.transport: local pg TCP; no managed HTTP claim

workBudgets.lockOrder: sorted resource rows, sorted subject rows, single budget row
workBudgets.internalWork: catalog lookup; up to 12 inserts/locks/freshness reads; up to two GCRA inserts/locks/checks/updates; account lock, attempt lookup, conditional debit and audit insert; lease updates
workBudgets.postProviderRelease: one counted query outside pre-provider timing; real publication/renewal outside this mock budget

limitations: local-only; no production route wiring, HMAC/auth or managed transport proof
freshness expires after genuine five-minute idle; explicit qualified observation required to recover
WAF exhaustion availability unverified; no WAF assumption needed for credit correctness
200/140 ms and log-only policy values remain owner decisions
